falas: Meet Leo, a nine-year-old inventor.
In his garage he builds a robot out of old toasters.
The robot blinks, beeps, and says his name.
prompts: A boy in goggles tinkers with wires in a cluttered garage workshop.
A clunky robot made of chrome toasters sits on a workbench, sparks flying.
The toaster robot's eyes light up blue as the boy grins in amazement.

falas: Meet Riley. She is seven.
Her big brother Jake teaches her to ride a bike. Jake runs beside her, holding the seat, then lets go.
Riley rides alone for the first time.
prompts: A small girl in a pink helmet wobbles on a bicycle on a quiet suburban street.
An older boy runs beside the bike holding the seat, both laughing.
The girl pedals alone down the street, arms steady, beaming.

falas: Meet Walter, a retired sailor. Every dawn Walter feeds the gulls on the harbor wall.
One gull, missing a foot, always waits for him.
Walter names her Pegleg.
prompts: An elderly man in a navy peacoat scatters bread on a stone harbor wall at dawn.
A seagull with one foot hops along the wall toward him.
The old man smiles and gently offers bread to the one-footed gull.

falas: Meet Lily, whose dad is a fisherman. Every morning she waves at his boat from the pier.
One day the boat does not come back.
Lily grabs a lantern and runs along the shore, calling his name.
prompts: A little girl waves from a wooden pier at a small fishing boat heading out at sunrise.
An empty grey sea under a storm sky, no boat on the horizon.
A girl holding a lantern runs along a dark rocky shore, shouting into the wind.

falas: Conoce a Mateo, un niño de seis años que le tiene miedo al mar.
Su abuelo Ernesto, un viejo pescador, lo lleva en su bote.
Mateo ve un delfín y se ríe por primera vez.
prompts: A six-year-old boy clings to his grandfather's arm on a small wooden boat.
An old fisherman with a white beard rows calmly across a calm blue sea.
A dolphin leaps beside the boat and the little boy laughs.

falas: Meet Tiger, a boxer from Detroit. Tiger trains every morning before dawn.
He has never lost a fight.
Tonight, under the lights, he faces the champion.
prompts: A muscular young man in a grey hoodie skips rope in a dim Detroit gym before dawn.
Close-up of taped fists hitting a heavy bag, sweat flying.
A boxer walks toward a bright ring under arena lights, crowd roaring.

falas: Dawn is a shy girl who has never spoken in class. Today Dawn raises her hand.
The whole room goes quiet.
She answers, and the teacher smiles.
prompts: Dawn breaks over a small town school, golden light on the windows.
A shy girl at a wooden desk slowly raises her hand in a quiet classroom.
A kind teacher smiles at the front of the class.

falas: Austin is a street drummer in downtown Austin.
He plays on overturned buckets for tips.
One night a famous producer stops, listens, and hands him a card.
prompts: A busy downtown Austin street at night, neon signs glowing.
A young man drums on overturned plastic buckets on a sidewalk, crowd gathering.
A man in a suit hands a business card to the drummer.

falas: Coco the parrot lives with Grandma Edna.
Every morning Coco wakes Edna by singing her favorite song.
One morning Edna does not wake up, and Coco flies to the neighbor for help.
prompts: A bright green parrot sings on a perch beside a sleeping old woman's bed.
The parrot flaps urgently around the quiet bedroom.
The parrot taps its beak on a neighbor's window, a man looks out surprised.

falas: Noah is afraid of the dark.
Every night his night-light flickers.
Tonight it goes out completely, and a small glowing firefly drifts into his room.
prompts: A little boy hides under his blanket in a dark bedroom, a night-light flickering.
The night-light goes dark; only moonlight through the window.
A tiny glowing firefly drifts above the boy's bed, lighting his amazed face.
